prompt:
Write the appraiser's remarks (about 80 words) on a body shop repair estimate after a side impact at intersection. Describe the damage seen on the vehicle and the repair plan. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1382; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The damage is mostly in line with the described impact.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
- The repair labor hours fit the damage.
- No earlier damage to the vehicle is known.
text: Inspection of the driver-side doors, rear quarter panel and B-pillar shows crushed metal and cracked trim consistent with a side impact at an intersection. Most of the deformation lines up with the account of how the collision occurred. The repair plan calls for replacing the front door shell, straightening the rear quarter panel, refinishing affected panels and replacing the side mirror assembly. Labor hours requested fit the extent of the damage, and the parts and charges listed on the invoice do not repeat. No prior damage to this vehicle is known from our records or the owner's report.
